ruleDefinitions.name: PowerShell Script Change Permission Via Set-Acl - PsScript
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects PowerShell scripts set ACL to of a file or a folder Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-Acl\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-AclObject\\ .*") AND ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\-Path\\ .*"))
